product_launches.description: Femtech startup Liv Labs launched its first product, the Pippa Resistance Spring, a wearable device designed to improve pelvic floor fitness during exercise, now available to consumers online starting at $149.

overview_description.description: Liv Labs makes convenient self-care products and services to improve pelvic floor fitness. Our flagship product is a silicone resistance spring worn internally (by women) to activate pelvic floors muscles during exercise. Our larger mission is to put people in expert control of their own fitness and physical wellbeing. We seek to serve people from all walks of life, around the globe.
